notes.title: 2nd Major Update
notes.content:
We have released the latest update for Pornocrates Osiris's Seed.
The main change is in the performance of the game.
Previously, the game had a low FPS count. This issue has been fixed. 
We've made other changes to the scene structure to make the experience much more enjoyable for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286292/8a74bbca95b486036caf87339f33e13cd5a3c2f9.jpg[/img]

Soon we will present more news.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41286292/9723eed5a5ca6b5d475f53577e72c3c7cbdbce18.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update scheduled for the second half of January.
notes.content:
We will release an update that will fix all current issues with this Early Access game. The game's narrative structure will be fixed as well.
The current level is introductory. The main adventure will take place on the second level (which is available, but still in development. Upon entering the second level the player will have a spoiler of what the environment of the next level of the game will be like).

notes.title: 1st Regular Update 31 December 2021
notes.content:
The 1st Regular Update is scheduled to be released on December 31, 2021.
The objective is to fix bugs in every level of the game and expand the Pornocrates Osiris's Seed universe.
This update requires you to completely uninstall the previous version to install the new update.

Some items that will be fixed:
Abandon the testing process and introduce ONE DEFINITE, PLAYABLE version (the Game is EARLY ACCESS AND WILL CONTINUE THAT WAY FOR TWO MORE MONTHS).

Although the game has passed the minimum requirements for Early Access, we believe it needs a lot of improvement. Let's not wait for the definitive release to introduce an acceptable game. We will do this as soon as possible.

Eliminate bugs in Cutscenes.
Equip the Villain of the story.
Fix Save System and other BUGS (because there are many).
Etc...

notes.title: First Patch Update: NOVEMBER 26
notes.content:
=== First Patch Update: NOVEMBER 26 ===

This game is like Early Access. The goal is to upload one important update per week (with the exception of one update that will be uploaded on November 19th).

Corrections are being made:
terrain adjustments at some points.
Implementation of elements that will expand the game's plot.
Preparation of the next levels of the game and introduction of new Cutscenes.

Bug fixes and narrative structure.
